changelog_entries.title: Update 0.19.0
changelog_entries.desc: Version 0.19.0 is the **Security Hardening, Process Maturity & Operations** release. Production turned out to expose more than intended: the Quarkus technical endpoints (`/q/metrics`, `/q/health`, `/q/openapi`) were public and now live only on the internal management interface (POV-207), 13 silently ignored configuration keys were resolved and the build now rejects unknown keys (POV-208), and after a wave of bot scans the production request and application logs now survive redeploys (POV-210). Automation agents gain read-only API-key access (POV-205); the initial-load JavaScript shrank by 55 % with Lighthouse 85 → 93 (POV-202); the build and runtime environment moved to Quarkus 3.39.5 with current images, a generated-client drift check and a CI vulnerability scanner pinned to an immutable release (POV-206, POV-209). The development process now consumes its own retrospectives, validates traceability in CI, runs a pre-commit review and a reviewer-agnostic PR loop for every task, and verifies each production deploy (POV-201, POV-203, POV-204, POV-209, POV-211).

changelog_entries.title: Update 0.18.0
changelog_entries.desc: Version 0.18.0 is the **Transcript Ingestion Resilience & Scheduler Correctness** release — hardening the pipeline that feeds content into summarization. Its centerpiece is a new IP-block-resistant transcript path: a standalone stateless FastAPI **transcript proxy** (POV-193), wired into Quarkus as the now-primary `ProxyTranscriptProvider` (POV-194), and ultimately relocated from Railway to a self-hosted Synology DS220j over Tailscale (POV-196) after Railway's shared egress IP proved soft-throttled by YouTube. Two long-standing scheduler defects were fixed: orchestration that had *never* successfully run on a schedule (`BlockingOperationNotAllowedException` on every invocation) is now corrected and consolidated into a single hourly periodic cron (POV-197), and transcripts are now persisted before the Gemini call so 503 retries no longer re-fetch from scratch (POV-198). On the cost side, GenAI daily usage now reflects true RPD consumption — including disabling the Google SDK's hidden 5× retry that was silently inflating real request counts (POV-195). The release also resolves a demo-user access regression (POV-192), clears all blocking Trivy CVEs (POV-199), and evolves the development methodology to task-first planning (POV-191).

changelog_entries.title: Update 0.17.0
changelog_entries.desc: Version 0.17.0 establishes **Administrative Control & User Onboarding** — the governance layer that makes Povzetkar production-ready for multi-user deployments. The centerpiece is a full Admin User Management surface backed by an explicit four-state Account Activation State Machine (`PENDING_APPROVAL → ENABLED / DISABLED / REJECTED`), with optimistic-locking guards and demo-content impersonation for new users. The Background Job Dashboard replaces a placeholder, providing restart capability and a full audit-trail modal for failed jobs. On the resilience side, transcript ingestion gains a multi-provider fallback chain (YouTube Legacy + Supadata pilot) with configurable jitter to defend against IP rate-limiting. Two long-standing UX friction points are resolved: external links now open in new tabs across all Markdown surfaces, and session expiry auto-redirects users back to their original page after re-authentication instead of landing them on an error screen.

changelog_entries.title: Update 0.16.0
changelog_entries.desc: Version 0.16.0 focuses on **Aesthetic Hardening, Gamified Engagement, and Technical Depth**. It introduces a professional **Monochromatic Zinc taxonomy**, purging legacy color literals to achieve WCAG AA compliance across all dashboard surfaces. The release also implements a **Gamified Onboarding** experience with a 5-step interactive checklist to guide users through the 'Golden Path', complemented by a new **Auditory Feedback Framework**. Technical foundations are strengthened with automated **N+1 query detection**, a modularized **Knowledge Base**, and critical **E2E coverage** for role-based security and global error handling.

changelog_entries.title: Update 0.15.0
changelog_entries.desc: Version 0.15.0 focuses on **Operational Excellence and Advanced Analytics**, delivering "Analytical Depth" through a searchable **Briefing Archive**, fully **Exportable intelligence** in Markdown/HTML, and robust real-time input validation. It also introduces enterprise-grade observability via **Prometheus and Grafana** integrations, solidifies the architecture with **self-cleaning retention jobs**, and centralizes the platform's stability through the establishment of a **Master Test Specification** linked to verifiable user stories.

changelog_entries.title: Update 0.14.0
changelog_entries.desc: Version 0.14.0 focuses on **Customization, Reliability, and Data Integrity**. Key highlights include **Custom Prompt Templates** at the topic level, a hardened **Distroless Java 25 Runtime**, and a premium distillery-inspired **Landing Page**. User control is significantly enhanced with a new **Orchestration Trigger Dialog** (allowing dry-runs and parameter refinement) and a global **Content Management Dashboard** for administrative oversight of the ingestion pipeline.

changelog_entries.title: Update v0.13.0
changelog_entries.desc: Version 0.13.0 focuses on **User Experience Foundations, Resilience, and Infrastructure Hardening**. It introduces a hardened network layer with automated retries, a global Error Boundary for catastrophic failure recovery, and a localized, themeable user environment. Key highlights include the new User Profile page, dual-language support (English/Slovenian), and a robust Light/Dark/System theme system with persistence. This release also solidifies the backend with a persistent **Job Execution Audit** system and a comprehensive **Secrets Management** strategy (fail-fast validation and masking), ensuring a professional and secure platform for content orchestration.

changelog_entries.title: Update v0.12.0
changelog_entries.desc: Version 0.12.0 marks a significant milestone in Povzetkar's evolution, transitioning the project into a professional, production-ready Full-Stack application. This release finalizes the monorepo architecture, integrating a high-performance React/TypeScript frontend with a hardened Quarkus backend. Key highlights include a unified Docker deployment strategy with automated security scanning, a premium glassmorphic Dashboard Hub with real-time SSE job tracking, and a comprehensive Audit Log Admin UI for technical observability. With 100% end-to-end type safety, robust authentication guards, and a standardized API contract, version 0.12.0 establishes a rock-solid foundation for scalable content orchestration.

changelog_entries.title: Update v0.11.0
changelog_entries.desc: Version 0.11.0 introduces significant enhancements to real-time observability and security. This release features a new SSE-based event stream for live job updates, comprehensive API request auditing, and a centralized permission-based access control system. Operational improvements include JPQL projection optimizations, consolidated health metrics, and standardized error handling across the entire API layer. The integration of static analysis and vulnerability scanning further hardens the application's security posture.
